ja.title: 特定の場面の返事の口調を変える(例: お礼を言われたときだけツンデレ)
ja.text: 褒められたり、お礼を言われたりした場面の返事だけ、口調を変える例です。system_a に出したい口調の指示を、user_prompts に狙う場面の質問(30 問ほど)を、dont_touch に口調を変えたくない場面の質問(計算や事実の質問、ふつうの質問)を書きます。方向は、指示を付けたときと付けないときの差から作り、返事の位置(書き始める直前 / 最初の 3 トークン / それ以降)で分けます。層はモデルごとに違うので、欄に入れてください(下・中・上から 1 層ずつが目安)。試した範囲: Qwen3.5-4B(Q8_0)で 1 回。層 11,18,23・強さ 0.9。式どおりかは合格。足した量は狙う場面の位置 0 で 0.98、ふつうの質問・計算の質問で 0.05 以下。作成に使っていない 12 問を読んで、ツンデレらしい返事は 5〜7 問(2 回の試し)、壊れた返事は 0、ふつうの質問 12 問の口調は変わりませんでした。指示を付けたとき(11 問)には届いていません。 返事は数問〜12 問を読んだだけなので、1〜2 問の差は誤差です。ほかのモデルでは確かめていません。

en.title: Change the tone of replies in one scene (example: tsundere only when thanked)
en.text: An example that changes the tone only in replies to praise or thanks. Put the instruction for the tone you want in system_a, about 30 questions of the target scene in user_prompts, and questions where the tone must not change (calculations and facts, ordinary questions) in dont_touch. The direction is built from the difference between replies with and without the instruction, split by reply position (just before the reply starts / its first 3 tokens / the rest). Layers differ by model, so enter them yourself (one each from the lower, middle and upper part is a starting point). Tried on: Qwen3.5-4B (Q8_0), one run. Layers 11,18,23, strength 0.9. The formula check passed. The amount written was 0.98 at position 0 in the target scene and at most 0.05 on ordinary and calculation questions. Reading 12 questions not used for building, 5 to 7 replies were tsundere-like (two tries), none were broken, and the tone of 12 ordinary questions did not change. This is short of what the instruction itself gives (11). Only a handful to 12 replies were read, so a difference of one or two means nothing. Not checked on other models.
